title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Matthew 7: judging others, asking and receiving, the narrow gate, false prophets and the house on the rock.

questions.text: How does Jesus say you will be judged?
questions.explanation: With whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged, and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

answers.text: With the judgment of the scribes
With the same judgment you use to judge
By the measure of the law of Moses

questions.text: What must you first remove from your own eye?
questions.explanation: Jesus says to first remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

questions.text: What does Jesus say not to throw before the pigs?
questions.explanation: He says not to give what is holy to the dogs, and not to throw your pearls before the pigs.

questions.text: What happens to the one who knocks?
questions.explanation: Ask and it will be given you, seek and you will find, knock and it will be opened for you.

answers.text: It will be opened for him
He will be given a stone
He will be handed a serpent

questions.text: What does Jesus say about the way that leads to life?
questions.explanation: He says the gate is narrow and the way that leads to life is restricted, and few are those who find it.

answers.text: It is wide, and many enter it
It is hidden, and no one finds it
It is narrow, and few find it
It is smooth, and all may walk it

questions.text: By what will they know the false prophets?
questions.explanation: Jesus says that by their fruits you will know them, and asks whether grapes are gathered from thorns.

answers.text: By their words in the synagogue
By the gifts they ask for

questions.text: What does Jesus say a good tree cannot do?
questions.explanation: A good tree can't produce evil fruit, and a corrupt tree can't produce good fruit.

questions.text: Who will enter the Kingdom of Heaven, according to Matthew 7:21?
questions.explanation: Not everyone who says Lord, Lord will enter, but he who does the will of the Father who is in heaven.

answers.text: The one who does the will of the Father
Everyone who prophesies in his name
Everyone who casts out demons in his name

questions.text: On what did the wise man build his house?
questions.explanation: The wise man built his house on a rock, and when the rain, floods and winds beat on it, it did not fall.

questions.text: Why were the multitudes astonished at his teaching?
questions.explanation: They were astonished because he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

answers.text: He taught with authority, not like the scribes
He spoke only in parables to them
He taught in the temple at Jerusalem
He quoted the scribes word for word
